description: This file defines the IGrainActivator interface in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which provides methods for creating and disposing grain instances within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IGrainActivator
classes.description: An interface for creating and disposing grain instances based on grain context.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new grain instance for the specified grain context.

methods.name: DisposeInstance
methods.description: Disposes of the specified grain instance associated with the given grain context.
